test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 12 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **who**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Who' **is used to refer to a person or people.

 
 
• **For example**: The woman who won the race is my friend.
 
 
 
• In this question, we are referring to a person or people, so 'who' will fill in the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Which' **is used to refer to things or animals.
 
• **'Whose' **is used to show possession.
 
• **'That' **can be used to refer to people or things, but it is not as specific as 'who'.
